verdict.rationale: Fin has event-adjacent automation: webhooks deliver real-time notifications for events such as contact creation or incoming conversations, and there are Fin workflows, escalation rules, Procedures and Tasks that can take actions in external systems. However, the evidence never explicitly describes a user-defined event→condition→action rule engine. Workflows and escalation rules appear only as help-article titles, and webhooks only notify, so acting on events needs your own handler. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of configurable event triggers with conditions and automatic actions, detail on workflow trigger types, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
